Work of the subcommittees, and the complaint about encroachment on headwater forest to grow ginger
se: Meeting on Tuesday 17 November 2026 at 14.30, committee room CA 429, 4th floor, Parliament House. According to the meeting notice, the agenda is the work of the subcommittees and the complaint about encroachment on headwater forest to grow ginger in Chai Prakan district, Chiang Mai, with the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation, the Royal Forest Department, the Department of Provincial Administration, the National Land Policy Office, Chiang Mai province, the Forest Industry Organization and the Natural Resources and Environmental Crime Suppression Division invited. The summary will be added after the Senate publishes it.
it: Complaint about encroachment on headwater forest to grow ginger, Chai Prakan district, Chiang Mai

How to prosecute illegal dumping of industrial and hazardous waste
se: The committee studied how to prosecute those who illegally dump industrial and hazardous waste on private land in Phachi district, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya; Ban Khai district, Rayong; Si Thep district, Phetchabun; Klang Dong district, Nakhon Ratchasima; and Rang Bua subdistrict, Chom Bueng district, Ratchaburi, with the Lawyers Council of Thailand under the Royal Patronage invited. Representatives of the public described the hardship caused by factories and chemical warehouses in the areas, which affect the environment and health and have caught fire several times; this is information from complainants that the agencies are still checking.
it: How to prosecute illegal dumping of industrial and hazardous waste (Lawyers Council)
